data.name: Augment
data.description: As a standard action, you can touch a creature and grant it either a +%1 enhancement bonus to a single ability score of your choice or a +%2 bonus to natural armor that stacks with any natural armor the creature might possess. This augmentation lasts %3 rounds. You can use this ability %4 times per day.|AugmentEnhancementBonus|min(ArcanistSavantSchoolLVL/5+1,5)|max(ArcanistSavantSchoolLVL/2,1)|INT+3
